leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a TypeScript interface to define pagination state structure
Construct a custom React hook that manages pagination logic
Initialize pagination state with typed default values
Manipulate pagination state through typed handler functions
Configure the hook to accept and enforce type-safe parameters
Integrate the pagination hook with a component to control data display
Apply TypeScript generics to make the pagination hook reusable across data types
